DEVCON Brand Kit and logos

Official logos, colors, type, key visuals, and boilerplate for chapters, partners, and media. Use them to keep DEVCON consistent everywhere.

Logos

Pick the right version

Use black text on light backgrounds and white text on dark ones. Full-resolution files are in the shared folder.

  • Black text, horizontalFor light backgroundsDownload PNG

  • Black text, squareFor light backgroundsDownload PNG

2026 anniversary mark

DEVCON 17: Engineering an AI-Ready Nation

Use the gradient 17 mark with the four-point star for 2026 anniversary materials, next to the main DEVCON logo, never in place of it.

Typography

Montserrat, everywhere

DEVCON uses Montserrat (free on Google Fonts). Use 900 or 800 for headlines, 700 or 600 for labels and buttons, and 400 for body text.

Usage

Do’s and don’ts

Do

  • Leave clear space around the logo, at least the height of the “D”
  • Use the white version on photos and dark backgrounds
  • Keep the logo at least 120 px wide on screen
  • Write the name as DEVCON, in capitals
  • Say “13 locations” when describing the network

Don’t

  • Stretch, rotate, or crop the logo
  • Recolor the four circles or the wordmark
  • Add shadows, outlines, or effects
  • Place it on busy backgrounds where it’s hard to read
  • Rebuild the logo from scratch; use the official files
Boilerplate

About DEVCON, ready to paste

Short (for posts and programs)

DEVCON Philippines (DevConnect Philippines Inc.) is the Philippines’ largest volunteer tech community: a non-profit founded in 2009, with 13 locations nationwide. In 2026, DEVCON 17 carries the theme Engineering an AI-Ready Nation.

Long (for press and proposals)

DevConnect Philippines Inc. (DEVCON) is a non-profit organization that empowers tech professionals, developers, and future geeks to share knowledge, solve challenges, and build impactful initiatives through technology. DEVCON champions Filipino developers on a global scale, in academe, government, and industry. As the country’s largest community of tech experts, enthusiasts, and volunteers, DEVCON reaches 70k+ people online and runs 120+ free events a year across 13 locations in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. Since 2009, DEVCON has held some of the biggest developer summits in the Philippines, on software development, AI, data science, and the future of work.
